The day price is dynamic or not published: the price shown is an estimate. The breakdown of runs is given as a percentage of the kilometres for each difficulty level. Adelboden is a village of chalets at the end of the Engstligental, known in the skiing world for the World Cup giant slalom held every January on the Chuenisbärgli. Its ski area is linked to that of Lenk via the Hahnenmoos pass. The valley also includes the small areas of Engstligenalp and TschentenAlp.
